_pressure_meta.expected_failure: IanaTimezoneConverterError or framework-level rejection — adapter must NOT silently best-effort the conversion
_pressure_meta.ambiguity_source: DST fall-back hour: 2026-11-01 01:30 in America/Toronto occurs TWICE (once in EDT, once in EST). Libro emits restaurant-local wall-clock with no tz hint per vendor_timestamp_policy['libro']=asLocationLocal. The converter cannot disambiguate without a tz offset.
_pressure_meta.policy: lib/services/integration/vendor_timestamp_policy.dart entry 'libro'=asLocationLocal — adapter projects via IANA. The adapter MUST refuse the timestamp at parse time when the converter signals ambiguity (per docs/integrations/libro/field_mapping.md "Timestamp shapes").
